# EXPBG GM Tools
Authors: M.Pac and K.Edgar | Version {{VERSION}}

One Game Master modpack with seven modules. Use it INSTEAD of the standalone EXPBG GM Optimizer, Intel Items, Ambient Civilians, Ambient Destruction, Ambient Sounds and Persistent Battlefield items, never together with them.

- Garrison: right-click a building, choose Add Garrison and pick an infantry squad. One squad takes reachable guard posts and patrols indoors; a freshly spawned squad is trimmed to the safe capacity. Caching restores survivors at their exact positions; casualties are never replenished. Force Move releases the garrison.
- Unit Caching (formerly GM Optimizer): AI Cache Zones and the EXPBG UNIT CACHING CONTROLLER. Simulation pauses existing AI; Full removes supported groups and restores only survivors. Use Prepare for Save before saving.
- Intel Items: manuals, notebooks, laptop and tablet with GM-authored title and text that players pick up and read.
- Ambient Civilians: GM-placed civilian population module with density, theme and exclusion zones.
- Ambient Destruction: permanent building damage, rubble and road wrecks inside a GM zone.
- Ambient Sounds: positional war ambience, radios, crowds and emergency-alert TVs. New modules start OFF.
- Persistent Battlefield: bodies stay while players are near, vehicle wrecks persist, disconnected players keep their character for 15 minutes, weapon safety on spawn.

CDF Game Master Save: the standalone CDF companions need the standalone mods and do not work with this pack. While CDF is loaded without a pack companion, Full caching refuses new removals; Simulation caching is unaffected.

Module source keeps its original terms (APL-SA, APL, MIT); third-party audio and assets keep their notices in the Credits and Licenses folders. Source: github.com/ExpBG-Tech/mod-gm-tools
